title: Desperado
line: A piece that is lost anyway takes something with it.

steps.text: Black's pawn has forked your knight and your bishop. One of them is lost, unless one takes something first.
The knight is lost anyway, so let it take Black's knight first.

wrong.f4g5: That saves the bishop, but the pawn takes your knight for nothing.
wrong.f4e3: That saves the bishop, but the pawn takes your knight for nothing.
wrong.f4g3: That saves the bishop, but the pawn takes your knight for nothing.

steps.hint: Your knight can capture before it is captured.

steps.text: Now save the bishop, to a square where it pins the knight to the queen.
steps.after: Both of your pieces got out of the fork.

summary: When a piece is lost anyway, let it take something first. Here a forked knight trades itself before it falls.
